fields.summary: This third amendment adds $198,000 to Lowe Consulting Group's contract for Project Labor Agreement services, which focus on hiring local residents and union representation and on monitoring prevailing wages and local apprentices. The attached amendment shows the not-to-exceed amount going from $558,000 to $756,000 (the agenda text says $588,000), and the term is extended 365 days, from June 30, 2022 to June 30, 2023. All other terms stay the same.

22-1453.note: The prior not-to-exceed amount was first shown as $588,000 as printed in the agenda text; the attached amendment shows $558,000, so it is corrected here. The $198,000 increase and $756,000 new total are unchanged.
22-1453.sourceIssue: The text gives the prior not-to-exceed amount as $588,000, but $588,000 plus the $198,000 increase is $786,000, not the stated $756,000; the attached amendment shows the prior amount was $558,000.

22-1632.sourceIssue: The text prints the Coverage II cost as $43,533.16, but 34,566 participants x $1.26 is $43,553.16 (as shown in the attached form), so the two line items total the stated $54,001.48; the title also says Fiscal Year 2021-2022 while the text and attachment say 2022-2023.
